title: The Lemon Curd in the Jar
youtube_title: The Lemon Curd in the Jar | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow finish can be the right finish.
summary: At a ceramic studio table where slip and handles must set, Kira wants to check on a jar of lemon curd that needed to thicken before it is ready. With Nana Ruth nearby, Kira leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
